properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-08-30: *"reflow2 has 'governance and management' set of nodes and edges that I don't think we use well and may not be mature yet."*

MEASURED THE SAME DAY against the committed export, because the instinct was checkable:

    GOVERNED_BY edges      1086     carries essentially the whole layer
    DesignRule               21     healthy, and mostly release/process lessons
    Constraint                4     ALL FOUR about reflow2's own performance
                                    (sweep cost, hydrate cost, pairing scope) —
                                    not one regulatory or contractual limit
    QualityGate               0     type declared, never instantiated
    EnvironmentRule           0     type declared, never instantiated
    GATED_ON edges            0
    COMPLIES_WITH edges       0
    IMPOSES edges             0
    VIOLATES_RULE edges       0

⭐ SO IT IS NOT EVENLY IMMATURE. One edge type does all the work and six pieces of vocabulary have never been used once. That is a different problem from "the layer needs more features", and it lands squarely on a rule this design already holds: `req:a-vocabulary-distinction-proves-it-is-read` says a distinction no computation reads should be MADE REAL OR REMOVED. Six of these are currently neither.

═══ THE HONEST COUNTER-ARGUMENT ═══
Zero instances on REFLOW2'S OWN design proves little about the vocabulary, because reflow2 is a software project with no permits, no inspections and no regulator. `rule:the-self-host-always-trails-what-it-teaches` says exactly this — the self-host is not the test of whether a domain concept earns its place. The right evidence is a design that HAS a regulator, and Anthony has just said he intends to start one (the biodome, `dec:idea-a-design-that-belongs-to-several-domains-at-once`). Deciding this before that project runs would be guessing.

═══ OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN ═══
(a) WAIT FOR THE BIODOME. It is the first design that will have real preconditions, and it is weeks away rather than hypothetical. Cheapest, and it produces evidence instead of opinion.
(b) BUILD THE ENVIRONMENT COMPLIANCE LAYER, which `dec:idea-the-environment-compliance-layer-was-designed-and-never-built` already says *"is what makes 'design a house' concrete"*. EnvironmentRule's zero count is that decision showing up as data.
(c) REMOVE WHAT NOTHING READS, per the design's own rule. Honest and cheap, and it loses vocabulary that may be exactly right the moment a non-software design arrives.
(d) LEAVE IT AND SAY SO IN THE DOCS — the layer is declared, untravelled, and known to be. Costs nothing and stays true whichever of the others happens.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether QualityGate and EnvironmentRule are the right shapes at all, or were designed before anyone had a case to fit them to. Nobody has tried to model a permit with them.
properties.name: OPEN — the governance vocabulary is one heavily-used edge and a lot of zeroes. Is it immature, or is most of it a distinction nothing reads?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill while the current increment stays the priority. Recorded as open because the measurement proves the vocabulary is UNUSED and proves nothing about whether it is WRONG — reflow2's own design has no regulator, so its zeroes are weak evidence by the project's own self-host rule.
